mapper.select: SELECT u.idx, u.name, u.email, u.target_book_count AS targetBookCount, u.grade, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_book_list bl WHERE bl.u_idx = u.idx AND bl.status = 100) AS status FROM tb_users u WHERE u.email = #{email}
SELECT b.title, bl.finish_date FROM tb_book_list bl JOIN tb_users u ON bl.u_idx = u.idx JOIN tb_books b ON bl.b_idx = b.idx WHERE u.email = #{email} AND bl.status = 100 ORDER BY bl.finish_date DESC
